Sanitized observation from operator-provided nRF Connect screenshots (2026-10-19).
No device addresses, full device names, peripheral IDs or manufacturer payloads retained.

Device transport: LE only
Advertising type: Legacy
Flags AD: type 0x01, value 0x05 (LE limited discoverable; BR/EDR unsupported)
Appearance AD: type 0x19, value 0x03c4 (gamepad)
Local-name AD: type 0x09, value redacted, 15 data bytes
TX-power AD: type 0x0a, value -8 dBm
Repeated appearance AD: type 0x19, value 0x03c4
HID service AD: type 0x02 (incomplete 16-bit list), value UUID 0x1812

Observed AD length/type pairs, in displayed RAW order:
2/0x01, 3/0x19, 16/0x09, 2/0x0a, 3/0x19, 3/0x02
Lengths include type but exclude the length octet.
Combined size including length octets: 35 bytes.
HID record begins at combined offset 31.

A single legacy advertising/scan-response data payload is at most 31 bytes.
The displayed buffer therefore combines packets/data; it is not one primary PDU.
Primary-versus-scan-response boundary was NOT independently captured.
HID being scan-response-only is strongly suggested, not yet proven.
